clue.text: Black horse for a good queen

definitions.meaning: Black ... was the mare of the highwayman Dick Turpin in English legend
Good Queen ... was the popular name of Elizabeth I of England

explanation.surface: Someone picks a dark steed to suit a virtuous monarch.
explanation.definitionFit: Both names are traditional nicknames: the legendary highwayman's mare and the Tudor monarch Elizabeth I.

clue.text: The endless round of housework

parts.note: a ring with no end is a round thing, and a hula ring is swung round and round the waist like a never-ending chore

explanation.definitionFit: A circular band has no end, so it is literally an endless round.

clue.text: Fish for tea

definitions.meaning: a trout-like fish of cold lakes
old British slang for a cup of tea, from the Chinese word cha

explanation.definitionFit: One word names both a freshwater salmonid and, in British slang, a cuppa.

clue.text: A socially superior accomplice

parts.note: one's betters are those of higher social rank

explanation.surface: A snob helps commit a crime.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who aids or encourages a wrongdoer is an accomplice.

clue.text: The finest horses kept by a transfusion centre

definitions.meaning: thoroughbred horses bred for racing are called by this collective term
read literally, a supply of donated blood held in storage

explanation.surface: A blood bank somehow stables thoroughbreds.
explanation.definitionFit: Thoroughbreds are the pedigree racing stock; split, the word describes a hospital's reserve of donated blood.

clue.text: New phone boxes for those who dislike foreign types

indicators.note: making something new out of the clue's words means rearranging their letters

explanation.surface: Fresh telephone kiosks are installed for bigots who dislike outsiders.
explanation.definitionFit: Xenophobia is fear or hatred of strangers and foreigners.

clue.text: Lead one up the garden path, not the main road

definitions.text: Lead one up the garden path
definitions.meaning: an idiom meaning to mislead or divert someone from the point
a minor branch line or byway off the principal route

explanation.surface: Someone is misled away from the main road.
explanation.definitionFit: As a verb it means divert from the point; as a noun it is a branch track off the main line.

clue.text: Stock breeder for optimistic stockman

definitions.meaning: the male of cattle sires the herd
on the stock exchange, a speculator who expects prices to rise

explanation.surface: A farmer breeding cattle is cheerful about his herd.
explanation.definitionFit: The male bovine breeds livestock; a stock-market trader betting on rising prices has the same name.

clue.text: 1854 battle helmet

definitions.meaning: a Crimean War battle of 1854, scene of the Charge of the Light Brigade
a woollen hood covering head and neck, named after the battle

explanation.surface: A Crimean War engagement and a soldier's headgear.
explanation.definitionFit: The Crimean battle gave its name to the knitted head covering worn by troops there.

clue.text: Sea parted in such a way that it is no longer in the same place

definitions.text: no longer in the same place

indicators.note: says the letters of the preceding words are arranged differently

explanation.surface: The Red Sea parting so the waters are divided.
explanation.definitionFit: Things divided and set apart are no longer together.

clue.text: Trouble from the year dot?

parts.note: AD, anno domini, marks a year of the Christian era
a dot is round like the letter O

explanation.surface: Asking whether problems have existed since the beginning of time.
explanation.walkthrough: 'The year dot' means the very beginning; read cryptically it is AD followed by a zero-shaped O.
explanation.definitionFit: Fuss and bother is trouble.

clue.text: Coward backing Trotsky

indicators.note: the name is read from back to front

parts.note: Noel Coward was the English playwright and wit

explanation.surface: A timid man supports the Russian revolutionary.
explanation.definitionFit: Trotsky's first name, the Bolshevik leader born Lev Bronstein.

clue.text: Eastern Egyptian god for a long time

parts.note: E is the abbreviation for east
Ra is the Egyptian sun god

explanation.surface: An eastern deity worshipped for ages.
explanation.definitionFit: An epoch or age is a long stretch of time.

clue.text: Where orchestralists perform together

definitions.meaning: musicians play at a public performance
acting jointly, in agreement

explanation.surface: Orchestral players perform as one.
explanation.definitionFit: Literally at a musical performance; figuratively acting jointly.

clue.text: Virtuously doing well

definitions.meaning: in a good manner, behaving rightly
thriving, prosperous

explanation.surface: Someone behaving righteously and prospering.
explanation.definitionFit: Taken literally it means in a righteous manner; idiomatically it means prospering.

clue.text: Keep governor who is able to take in 17th century authoress

indicators.note: the first word encloses the other

parts.note: Mary Astell was an English writer born 1666, an early feminist

explanation.surface: A castle's governor proves able to entertain a 17th-century woman writer.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Keep' is the castle tower, not the verb.
explanation.definitionFit: The governor of a castle, the keep being its central stronghold.

clue.text: Invite a CO0 serving a term of apprenticeship before taking orders

definitions.text: a term of apprenticeship before taking orders

indicators.note: the words are put to service in a new order

parts.note: CO is the abbreviation for commanding officer; the 0 is a misprinted comma

explanation.surface: An officer is invited to serve a probationary term.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Taking orders' means entering holy orders: novices serve a probationary period first.
explanation.definitionFit: The probation period of a novice in a religious order before vows.

clue.text: Hyperbolic formula that is a real stunner

definitions.meaning: the hyperbolic cosine function in mathematics
a cudgel that knocks someone senseless

explanation.surface: An exaggerated recipe that knocks you out.
explanation.definitionFit: The abbreviation for hyperbolic cosine is also the British word for a bludgeon.

clue.text: The voice of one who plays no part

definitions.meaning: the grammatical voice in which the subject receives the action

definitions.text: of one who plays no part
definitions.meaning: describing someone inactive or submissive

explanation.surface: A singer who stays out of the performance.
explanation.definitionFit: In grammar it is a verb voice; in life it describes someone inert and inactive.

clue.text: Game of dominoes watched in the bull-ring

definitions.meaning: a dominoes game where tiles must total seven
the bullfighter who makes the kill

explanation.surface: Spectators at a bullfight play dominoes.
explanation.definitionFit: It names both a domino game and the Spanish bullfighter.

clue.text: Travel daily just to change a sentence

definitions.meaning: travel regularly between home and work
reduce a judicial punishment to a lesser one

explanation.surface: A convict hopes the daily journey will lighten his punishment.
explanation.definitionFit: Regular travel to work, and the legal act of lessening a penalty.

clue.text: Relief leading Republican senator

definitions.meaning: state unemployment benefit
Bob ..., US Senate Republican leader

explanation.surface: A prominent Republican senator offers welfare.
explanation.definitionFit: British slang for unemployment benefit, and the surname of Senator Bob Dole.

clue.text: He has a hunch the criminal has returned to town

explanation.surface: A detective suspects the villain is back in town.
explanation.definitionFit: An old word for a hunchback, a man with a crooked spine.

clue.text: Short cut for Robert Short

definitions.meaning: a short haircut
the short form of the name Robert

explanation.surface: Bob gets a trim.
explanation.definitionFit: A short hairstyle, and a diminutive of Robert.

clue.text: Fabricated lie Hawaiians hang about a visitor

indicators.note: something fabricated is made up, so the letters are put together anew

explanation.surface: Islanders tell a tall story to a tourist.
explanation.definitionFit: Hawaiians welcome guests with a garland of flowers hung round the neck.

clue.text: 1500050 is a figure some respect

parts.note: read as 1, 500, 0, 50 in Roman numerals I, D, O and L

explanation.surface: A number that commands reverence.
explanation.definitionFit: An object of worship or admiration is revered by its followers.

clue.text: Maybe regimental pipers in action are just a bunch of brigands

definitions.meaning: military musicians carrying weapons
a gang of bandits bearing weapons

explanation.surface: Regimental pipers are no better than robbers.
explanation.definitionFit: Read literally, a military musical group bearing weapons; idiomatically, an armed gang.

clue.text: A rising poet lacking in lustre

indicators.note: in a down entry the word is written upwards

explanation.surface: An up-and-coming poet who is rather dull.
explanation.definitionFit: Dull and colourless is lacking in lustre.

clue.text: First half of the alphabet is a very little matter

definitions.text: First half of the alphabet is a very little matter

parts.words: First half of the alphabet is a very little matter
parts.note: the first thirteen letters, named by their opening and closing letters joined by the word for a range, describe the smallest particle of matter

explanation.surface: Learning half one's letters is no great matter.
explanation.walkthrough: Name the first half of the alphabet as a range, first letter to thirteenth, and run the three words together.
explanation.definitionFit: The basic particle of a chemical element is an extremely small bit of substance.

clue.text: Tied and dragged

definitions.meaning: finished level in a game
pulled along

explanation.surface: Bound and hauled away.
explanation.definitionFit: Past tense of a verb meaning both to finish level and to haul.

clue.text: One in prison-for killing his brother?

indicators.note: the numeral goes inside the slang word

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: Someone jailed for fratricide.
explanation.walkthrough: The biblical Cain killed his brother Abel; the question mark admits the definition is by example.
explanation.definitionFit: In Genesis, Adam's son murdered his brother Abel.

clue.text: Additional insurance against being driven off

definitions.meaning: extra protection on a policy
a cricket fielding position that stops balls driven through the off side

explanation.surface: A motorist buys more insurance in case of theft.
explanation.definitionFit: Literally more cover; in cricket a fielding position guarding the off side.
